senses.gloss: f. (עָנָה II; cmp. עִינּוּי) trouble, suffering. Sifra B’ḥuck., Par. 2, ch. VIII (play on יען וביען, Lev. XXVI, 43) ע׳ של מדבר (Yalk. Lev. 675 עוֹנוֹת) the privations in the desert; ע׳ של בעל פעור (Yalk. l. c. של פעור) the suffering attendant upon the worship of Baal (Num. XXV, 3, Ps. CVI, 28, sq.); ע׳ של מלכי האמורי the suffering from the Emorite kings (Jud. II, sq.).—Pl. עוֹנוֹת.
units: <cite ref="Vayikra Rabbah 17:1">Lev. R. s. 17</cite> (play on <he>ח̇ר̇צ̇ב̇ות</he>, <cite ref="Psalms 73:4">Ps. LXXIII, 4</cite>, v. <cite ref="E00840"><he>הִרְהֵר</he></cite>) <he>ולא צ̇ב̇יתים בע׳</he> I did not make them swell from sufferings; <cite ref="Psalms 73:4">ib.</cite> <he>אין להם ציבים של ע׳ וכ׳</he> they (the wicked) have no swellings (accumulations) of sufferings with which they die (so as to atone for their sins) &c.; <cite ref="Yalkut Shimoni on Nach 808:9">Yalk. Ps. 808</cite>.
